name: twisitter
description: Tells you when X shows you your replies as normal but hides them from others.

scripts.clean: rimraf dist-chrome dist-firefox dist-chrome-dev dist-firefox-dev chrome.zip firefox.zip
scripts.build-chrome: rm -f chrome.zip && NODE_ENV=production BROWSER=chrome webpack && (cd dist-chrome && zip -qr ../chrome.zip . -x '*.DS_Store')
scripts.build-firefox: rm -f firefox.zip && NODE_ENV=production BROWSER=firefox webpack && (cd dist-firefox && zip -qr ../firefox.zip . -x '*.DS_Store')
scripts.build-all: yarn build-chrome-dev && yarn build-firefox-dev && yarn build-chrome && yarn build-firefox
scripts.preflight: yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn build-chrome-dev && yarn build-firefox-dev && yarn test:e2e
